title: Sanyu Stays Home
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Sanyu is sick and must stay home while others go to a party. She learns trust in hard times.
keywords: patience, sickness, trust, suffering, Uganda, girls, virtue
dedication: For every girl learning to trust when life feels unfair.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Sanyu is sick and can't go to the birthday party. She feels forgotten—until someone stays behind with her.
